rationale: Environmental conditions (warm, open) - vary by lineage ecology; not part of the syndrome per se
C4 photosynthesis itself - the whole-organism function, present in all C4 plants
Action at cellular/tissue level (CO2 fixation, rapid transport) - present in all C4 plants independent of origin
Emergent property of one component (bundle distance, PEPC activity) - vary among C4 lineages
Property of one component (bundle-sheath length, PEPC expression) - vary among C4 lineages
One cellular/enzymatic element (bundle-sheath cell, PEPC) - repeatedly co-opted, assembled in unique combinations
